verdict.rationale: Deel's own pages advertise a free eligibility check on its site, delivered digitally, with results within 48 hours that include a cost breakdown and document requirements. Its founders track lists O-1A and EB1-A. However, the check appears to be a human-reviewed assessment with a 48-hour turnaround rather than an instant self-serve qualifier, and nothing shows it is a structured tool built specifically for O-1/EB-1 criteria. Missing for 10: evidence of an instant self-serve questionnaire, O-1/EB-1-specific criteria scoring, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a free structured eligibility check — a self-serve O-1/EB-1 qualifier or assessment tool on the provider's site
